set protocols bgp group eBGP neighbor 19.template: set protocols bgp group [parameter1] neighbor [parameter2] family inet unicast

set protocols bgp group eBGP neighbor 19.explanation: 配置BGP邻居的标签分配策略为全部。

set policy-options policy-statement poli.template: set policy-options policy-statement [parameter1] term [parameter2] from protocol [parameter3]
set policy-options policy-statement poli.command: set policy-options policy-statement policy1 term 1 from protocol bgp
set policy-options policy-statement poli.explanation: 配置策略语句的匹配条件为BGP协议。

set policy-options policy-statement poli.explanation: 配置策略语句的动作，为匹配的路由添加标签。

set policy-options policy-statement poli.template: set policy-options policy-statement [parameter1] term [parameter2] then accept
set policy-options policy-statement poli.command: set policy-options policy-statement policy1 term 1 then accept
